about_the_game:
This is for those gitz who want to show their extra support of the game. We appreciate every one of you Speed Freekz, but if you feel like grabbin' this snazzy pack, we've crammed a bunch of cool things into it!

Contains :

  • Squig Pole Accessory

  • New Rim for Wheeled Vehicles

  • New Tread for Treaded Vehicles

  • Grot Supporter Pet

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i5-2500/ AMD Ryzen 1300X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (A minimum of 4 GB of VRAM) / Intel A580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel core i7-7700k/ AMD Ryzen 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6700-XT (A minimum of 4 GB of VRAM) / Intel A770
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
